name: Forensic
tagline: When a project is in trouble: what happened, why, what it is worth, and how to reset it.
problem: When projects fail, the causes and the cost are argued rather than established.
how: The project record and its documents
Tests the case, reconstructs events and quantifies delay
Claims and resets settled on evidence
features: Business case test: Eight checks on the risk arithmetic, in hours
Root cause analysis: Honest error, optimism or incentives, tested
Claims and disputes: Delay and disruption quantified against comparables
Project reset: An independent baseline generated at a declared confidence, with decision rights that hold it
notes: No running interface exists for this tool yet, so there are no screens.
